blog: Post 2: How accurate is your code graph?
highlights: client-go (hand-written): PipesHub 82.9 F1 at 99.4% precision, Graphify 73.6.
guava: PipesHub 79.0 F1, Graphify 55.9, codebase-memory-mcp 55.8, CodeGraphContext 6.7 (most of its calls resolve into the android/ copy of the same classes).
excalidraw: PipesHub 87.1 F1 against Graphify's 87.4; pipeshub-ai frontend 90.4 against 82.8. The rest of the excalidraw gap is exported constants, which PipesHub has no symbol for (B1-G7).
Best settings lifted the others on gin: Graphify 66.5 -> 79.0, codebase-memory-mcp 42.6 -> 70.7, CodeGraphContext 34.2 -> 68.9. PipesHub 86.5.
Without test files, PipesHub's django recall is 85.6 (77.2 with tests) and gin's 83.8 (76.5).
method: Compiler-grade truth from SCIP indexers (scip-python, scip-typescript, scip-go, scip-java). Every tool is scored on the same truth and the same relations: CALLS, IMPORTS, IMPORTS_FROM and inheritance.
question: Are the code graph's edges right on real code, and how does it compare with other code-graph tools?
repos: requests, django, pipeshub-ai backend (Python) · excalidraw, pipeshub-ai frontend (TypeScript) · gin, kubernetes/client-go (Go) · spring-petclinic, guava (Java)
summary: With every tool at its best settings, PipesHub has the best F1 on hand-written code on 8 of 9 repos; Graphify edges it on excalidraw, 87.4 against 87.1. PipesHub's precision is the highest or within one point of it on every repo.
